children: Shares of banks and other financial institutions fell amid concerns about rising credit stress.
The Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time in three years, taking back some of the monetary stimulus provided last year.
The vast majority of officials penciled in one more hike this year in the "dot plot" of projections released after their meeting.
Treasury yields were mostly higher in the wake of the decision.
